comment: Read by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs. 'copyright': crates for which no licence file with a real copyright notice exists in the crate or its repository. Their text is the licence template of cargo-about with the placeholder replaced by 'holder'. basis 'authors': holder is the authors field of the crate (checked against cargo metadata at the exact version). basis 'repository': holder named from the upstream repository, see 'source'. An entry is used only for the exact name and version, and an entry that is no longer needed is an error. 'webview2': Microsoft's WebView2 loader, linked statically on Windows from the files the webview2-com-sys crate carries; the licence text is the LICENSE.txt of that exact NuGet package version, and the hashes pin the files it applies to. 'signatureFonts': the script fonts of the signature picture, subset to Latin letters with fontTools (pyftsubset --unicodes=U+0020-007E,U+00A0-017F,U+2010-2015,U+2018-201E,U+2026 --layout-features= --no-hinting --notdef-outline), each pinned by the hash of the shipped file and of its licence text (the text with LF line ends, trimmed). A font file in assets/fonts/signature without an entry is an error.
